audit.inclusion_rule: A candidate is included when its tag resolves to a multi-platform OCI index or Docker manifest list that contains both linux/amd64 and linux/arm64 manifests. The index digest is pinned. Single-architecture candidates are excluded and logged. The evaluation itself runs on linux/amd64.
